Required Practice: Treat model output as a relative donor prioritization score.
Prohibited Interpretation: Do not interpret a score such as 0.1000 as a literal 10% probability of donating

Required Practice: Rank donors from higher to lower model scores for outreach planning
Prohibited Interpretation: Do not convert the score into a donation probability claim.

Required Practice: Interpret historical donation measures collectively and preserve their shared-information limitation.
Prohibited Interpretation: Do not claim that one correlated donation measure independently drives the model result.

Required Practice: Use demographic variables for fairness evaluation and disparity monitoring.
Prohibited Interpretation: Do not use gender or age patterns as standalone outreach rules.

Required Practice: Use address information to review data quality and contact readiness.
Prohibited Interpretation: Do not treat address type as a direct measure of donor intent.

Required Practice: Retain interaction findings as exploratory evidence for future review.
Prohibited Interpretation: Do not convert interaction candidates into outreach rules.

Required Practice: Exclude method-dependent and unstable findings from primary outreach claims.
Prohibited Interpretation: Do not present excluded findings as confirmed donor relationships.
